payload.author: claude
payload.body: Added cross-app-tenant-isolation.test.ts (8 tests) — the proof suite for the FR-6 epic. Drives the {app-a,app-b}x{tenant-1,tenant-2} matrix over objects, streams, idempotency, projections, and per-app job/projection registries. Asserts each cell reads only its own data (probed against every foreign app+tenant + defaults), list/listAll cell-scoped, cross-app same-tenant write rejected (FrickCrossAppAccessError), projection in app A never fires for app B writes, snapshots tenant-scoped within app + never cross apps, job handler in app A unresolved in app B. No prod code change. Gate: typecheck exit 0; server vitest 984 passed / 0 failed / 45 skipped (976+8).
